annotations.title: Create a product that is not public

description: Use this when the person explicitly asks to create a new product in their ProofPass account. Creates a product in the connected account that is not shown publicly and holds no documents, as "Neues Produkt" with "Nicht öffentlich zeigen" does in the dashboard. Refuses with the reason when the account holds no more products. Returns the id, the QR link and the dashboard link where documents are uploaded and the product is made public. Do not use to upload a document or publish a product, or to create products the person did not ask for; documents and publishing stay in the dashboard.

description.description: Two or three sentences on what the product is for

keywords.description: Search words, comma separated: old names, colours, pack sizes

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

name.description: Product name as it should appear
